bio: It is well worth coming to this small restaurant inside the impressive building designed by architectural firm Robertneun in the Lokdepot development. In the kitchen located on a gallery above the guests, Igor Kazakov turns out classic dishes with a modern, creative twist. There is a small à la carte menu with dishes designed for sharing – appetising options include zander, spinach, horseradish and onion, hay, Jerusalem artichoke. The restaurant adheres to a sustainable philosophy and uses only regional and seasonal ingredients. As hinted at by the decorative preserving jars on display, fermented foods also play an important role.
